'''''Dolichandra''''' is a genus of flowering plants in the family [[Bignoniaceae]], native to Latin America and the Caribbean.<ref name = "4063-1" /> They are climbing lianas with trifid and uncate tendrils.<ref>{{cite journal |doi=10.11646/phytotaxa.301.1.1 |title=Taxonomic Revision of Dolichandra (Bignonieae, Bignoniaceae) |year=2017 |last1=Fonseca |first1=Luiz Henrique M. |last2=Cabral |first2=Simone Miranda |last3=Agra |first3=Maria DE Fatima |last4=Lohmann |first4=Lúcia G. |journal=Phytotaxa |volume=301 |page=1 }}</ref> The best-known species is ''[[Dolichandra unguis-cati]]''.
